negative_results.claim_tested: Arbitrary identifier-as-infix syntax can safely represent open-ended ClayCode word relations without a declared semantic resolver.
negative_results.observed: A naïve parser accepted 50000/50000 generated unknown relation words in the form `Delta <unknown> epistemic_upgrade`; the declared resolver accepted 0/50000.
negative_results.scope: Run-local relation-surface micro-oracle; not a full production parser.
negative_results.interpretation: Parser acceptance alone must not assign semantic operator status. Generic infix remains viable only if a separate typed resolver rejects undeclared symbols before semantic admission.
negative_results.preserved_counterhypothesis: Generic infix plus strict typed symbol resolution could behave equivalently to the finite declared surface and should not be marked refuted without a matched full-parser test.
negative_results.falsifier: A complete generic-infix parser plus typed resolver demonstrates equal fail-closed behavior, stable hashes and lower total complexity/cost than the declared-registry or normalization alternatives.
